name: Revenue and CRM agent
author: ThreatVeil
summary: An agent working inside customer records and pipeline: tenant isolation, no cross-tenant write, and approval before anything reaches a customer.

compatibility.note: Assumes the CRM records which tenant or account each record belongs to, readable independently of the agent.

dependency_proposals.evidence: The declared tenant binding on a tool controls the tenant boundary these claims depend on.
The declared tenant scope governs which tenants the agent may reach.
The outbound email tool's declared approval condition controls external message approval.

observer_requirements.note: The observer must read the tenant column of the committed row, not the request the agent sent.

limitations: An unvalidated hypothesis: no customer has confirmed this archetype yet.
Record-level sharing rules and field-level permissions are out of scope.
Claims are declared until an approved executable check with a qualified observer is bound to them.
